name: word-captions
title: Word Captions
description: Burned-in captions in the styles big channels actually use — heavy Montserrat, a real outside outline so they read on any footage, and the spoken word springing to an accent. Four presets: beast, hormozi, pop, clean.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/captions/word-captions?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
